To remove a passenger from a reservation, I need the reservation ID. Could you please provide it?

I don’t have the reservation ID handy right now. My name is James Patel. Can you look it up under my account and just remove Sophia from the LAS–DEN round trip on May 19/20? I’d really like this done quickly, with the refund going back to the original payment method.
